title: Danger Alarm
blurb: Blaring, red-lit and entirely disproportionate — which is exactly what makes it useful. This klaxon converts any situation into a submarine emergency, and meme editing has established that most situations benefit from the upgrade. Somebody in the chat is visibly typing a paragraph? Danger alarm. The teacher says the words pop quiz? Danger alarm. A relative opens with 'I'm not being funny, but'? Full evacuation. The comedy comes from applying naval-grade urgency to something that could be resolved by leaving the room. Dive, dive, dive.
origin: The red-alert klaxon of meme edit culture.
